# AI Software Tutorials

> Machine-readable chapter companions and links to the canonical explanations.

Each public JSON companion contains a summary, short answers, source URLs and the complete original section HTML. Short answers do not replace setup details or testing limitations.

## Chapters

- [Conversation and basic tasks](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/conversation-basics/index.ai.json) — Learn to describe tasks, provide necessary context, set constraints and give actionable requirements, then revise prompts based on results. Continue with the interactive workflow, examples and FAQ.
  - [Canonical reading page](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/conversation-basics/)
  - [Are longer prompts always better?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/conversation-basics/#prompt-foundations)
  - [What context, constraints and actionable requirements should an AI prompt include?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/conversation-basics/#prompt-foundations)
  - [How can I diagnose an unsatisfactory AI response and revise my prompt?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/conversation-basics/#prompt-foundations)
- [I. What is an agent, and when should you use one?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/index.ai.json) — Understand how agents relate to models and workflows, how action and feedback loops work, and what tools, knowledge and memory do. Learn when an agent is appropriate and how to set permissions.
  - [Canonical reading page](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/)
  - [How do AI agents relate to models and workflows?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/#course-agent-topic-1)
  - [Why do agents need tools, knowledge, memory and feedback?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/#course-agent-topic-2)
  - [When should I use an agent, and how much autonomy and access should it have?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-foundations/#course-agent-topic-4)
- [II. How to build an agent](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-building/index.ai.json) — Start with a topic assistant, add a knowledge base, cross-conversation memory and voice, then configure scheduled or event-triggered background tasks. Review publishing, maintenance and licensing.
  - [Canonical reading page](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-building/)
  - [How can I build an assistant that uses my own knowledge base?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-building/#course-agent-building-topic-1)

- [III. How to find an agent](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/index.ai.json) — Distinguish agents, skills and harnesses, then explore specific directories and repositories for reusable agents, skills, runtimes and workflows, including conditions to check before use.
  - [Canonical reading page](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-discovery/)

- [IV. Automation workflows](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/automation/index.ai.json) — Learn to split workflows, assign work to models, programs and people, and design branches and checks. Explore ten examples, including onboarding guides, email-to-calendar tasks and customer inquiries.
  - [Canonical reading page](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/automation/)
  - [When should I split a task into separate workflow steps?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/automation/#course-agent-automation-topic-1)
  - [Which steps should be handled by a model, a program or a person?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/automation/#course-agent-automation-topic-2)

- [V. Evaluation and improvement](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/index.ai.json) — Explore four types of evaluation tools, a LangSmith walkthrough for datasets and scoring, and prompt-version comparisons. The chapter retains its documentation checks and untested-demo limitations.
  - [Canonical reading page](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/)
  - [What types of AI evaluation tools are available?](https://ai-knowledge-map.com/en/software/agents-automation/agent-evaluation/#course-agent-evaluation-topic-1)
